title.en: An Act to Designate the Date for the Opening of the Annual Sessions of the Philippine Legislature
title.orig: An Act to Designate the Date for the Opening of the Annual Sessions of the Philippine Legislature

text.en:
The Legislature shall hold annual sessions beginning on the sixteenth day of July of each year, or
if said sixteenth of July be a legal holiday, on the first day thereafter which is not a legal holiday.
All acts or parts of acts inconsistent with the provisions of this Act are hereby repealed.

This Act shall take effect on its approval.
Approved, February 28, 1924.
